result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including high-visibility crosswalks and signals, but the environment is dominated by a wide, multi-lane roadway. The lack of a median refuge and the long crossing distance significantly increase pedestrian exposure to high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radii
hazards.description: The wide corner design allows vehicles to maintain higher speeds while turning right, increasing conflict risk.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear in the asphalt surface within the crossing area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and reduce the unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: A wide signalized intersection with multiple travel lanes and marked zebra crosswalks. Pedestrian infrastructure includes sidewalks, curb ramps, and signals, but the large scale of the roadway results in significant exposure and long crossing distances.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Design
hazards.description: Wide lanes and a multi-lane configuration encourage higher vehicle speeds through the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Provide a safe space for pedestrians to wait if they cannot cross the entire street in one signal cycle.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with a single marked zebra crosswalk, indicating long exposure times for pedestrians. While traffic signals are present, the lack of medians, refuge islands, and consistent sidewalk infrastructure creates a high-stress environment for non-motorized users.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the marked crosswalk on the right.

hazards.name: Discontinuous Sidewalks
hazards.description: Sidewalks appear to end or are not clearly connected, potentially forcing pedestrians to walk on the shoulder or grass.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image and background areas along the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian access with marked crosswalks and sidewalks, but lacks advanced safety features like pedestrian signals or traffic calming. The roadway surface is in poor condition with visible cracking, which may pose a tripping hazard or affect vehicle braking.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and wear in the asphalt within the crosswalk area.

hazards.name: Absence of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and degraded roadway surface to improve safety for all users.
